why: swingfull_r530.py selects the Welch critical value from a two-value lookup, tcrit = 2.776 if df < 5 else 2.571, which is t(0.975, df=4) applied at df 4.117. SWINGFULL_r530.json therefore deposits an interval half a per cent too wide. The deposit is left as written rather than regenerated, because rewriting it would remove the evidence that it was ever wrong; this file supersedes its ci95 field and the manuscript quotes the corrected interval.
direction: the deposited interval is wider than the correct one, so the error was conservative
